item.title: GENE SIMMONS Confesses OZZY OSBOURNE Taught Him The One Lesson He Couldn’t Learn On Stage
item.description: Gene Simmons recently opened up about what he took away from decades of knowing Ozzy Osbourne. The KISS co-founder, now 75, reflected on the loss of Ozzy, who died July 22 at 76, during an appearance on David Duchovny’s podcast Fail Better.
